cohort: 517 parturients with a mean BMI of 33.9 kg/m(2) undergoing cesarean section utilizing endotracheal intubation
finding: The intubation difficulty scale (IDS) is a good tool for defining difficult intubation among obese parturients, with scores of ≥3 and ≥5 being optimal cutoff points to define somewhat difficult intubation and difficult intubation, respectively.
